correctness.rationale: The conic has q+1 isotropic lines; the cross-product square identity establishes regular nilpotence. Witt index one yields the D and I incidence counts, and the R row has a split orthogonal plane with exactly two isotropic lines. This proves the exhaustive transition matrix in odd characteristic. Integer recurrence and generating function follow from matrix algebra. 14 exhaustive state-count configurations over q=3,5,7,9 and symbolic hitting-time identities confirm boundaries; finite tests are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Successive products of the regular nilpotent so3 orbit are intrinsic to the simplest nonabelian orthogonal Lie algebra. Exact all-length rank and row-norm counts disclose a hidden state essential for predicting rank-one absorption, and two genuinely different q- and q²-scale degeneration regimes. This structural and quantitative information is not supplied by one-factor rank distributions or two-factor support tests.
